title: Third Shot Drop Choice (Michelle Grogan)
style: Latin-infused pop rock track at 128 BPM in D minor. The arrangement features a prominent nylon-string acoustic guitar playing flamenco-style rasgueados and staccato melodic runs. A driving percussion section consists of a four-on-the-floor kick drum, crisp snare hits on 2 and 4, and syncopated handclaps. A distorted electric guitar provides rhythmic stabs and high-gain lead fills. The bass guitar follows a syncopated Latin-rock pattern. Male vocals are delivered with a rhythmic, spoken-word quality in the verses, transitioning to melodic singing in the choruses. Production includes heavy reverb on vocal tails and sharp filter sweeps on the percussion during transitions.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[nylon-string guitar rasgueado, handclaps]
[distorted electric guitar slide]

[Verse 1]
[rhythmic male vocals]
Fifth ball comes deep
Returner pushes back the line
Server in the transition zone
Drop the ball
Into the kitchen
[fast nylon-string guitar run]

[Chorus]
[full band enters, driving kick drum]
Return deep to the back third
Server in the transition hurt
Third shot drop is the choice
Arc the ball, gentle voice
Vamos, vamos, drop the ball
Uno, dos, tres, soft and small
Landing 'side the kitchen line
Let them lift the ball fine
Drop, drop, drop
Arc and slow
Drop, drop, drop
Low and flow

[Bridge]
[distorted guitar stabs]
Third shot, drop choice
Third shot, drop choice
Arc and slow, arc and slow
Third shot, drop choice
Vamos amigos
Let it flow
[vocalizing] (Ooh-ah)

[Verse 2]
Wide drop and not drive
Because drive at the line they thrive
The drop forces them to lift
Give us time for a forward shift
Uno, dos, tres, four steps in
Mano, land it 'fore they spin
Apex above the tape soft
Landing low in the kitchen loft

[Outro]
Drop is high percentage shot
Drive only when the angle is hot
When receiver is at the kitchen
Drop is the smart pitching
Third shot, drop choice
Third shot, drop choice
Arc and slow, arc and slow
Third shot, drop choice
Vamos amigos
Let it flow
[nylon-string guitar flourish]
Drop, drop, drop
Arc and slow
Four steps in
Let it flow
[final drum hit]
